description: Declared Go-vs-reference divergence in the routing key: CUxD addresses are namespaced by the central on the Go side and are NOT namespaced by the Python reference. Kept in its own file so unique_id_golden.json / channel_unique_id_golden.json stay byte-identical copies of the shared cross-backend fixtures. `expected` is what Go emits; `reference_expected` is what the Python reference emits. tests/contract/routing_key_contract_test.go asserts Go == expected AND that the divergence is still real; script/routing_key_parity.py asserts Python == reference_expected AND that Python still differs from expected. Either side moving turns one of the two red instead of leaving `make routing-key-parity` silently green. Rationale + retirement condition: notes/parity/by_design.md -> BD-Identity-CUxDCentralScoping.
